name: webauthn-spc-demo
description: Demo de Secure Payment Confirmation (SPC) con WebAuthn

scripts.generate-certs: mkdir -p certs && openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -keyout certs/key.pem -out certs/cert.pem -days 365 -nodes -subj '/C=ES/ST=Madrid/L=Madrid/O=SPC Demo/CN=localhost'
scripts.clean-data: rm -rf data/* && echo '{}' > data/users.json && echo '{}' > data/challenges.json
scripts.setup: npm run generate-certs && npm run clean-data
